title: Closing the gap: Maz'ya-Shaposhnikova and asymptotics of fractional perimeters
summary: We prove a generalization of the Maz'ya-Shaposhnikova formula in the case $p=2$ for functions that may not belong to ${L^2}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ and, thus, might not vanish at infinity. By introducing a notion of mass at infinity, we explicitly characterize the limit as $s\to0^+$ of Gagliardo seminorms localized on a bounded Lipschitz domain $Ω$. By `localized', we mean here that we account only for interactions involving at least one point in $Ω$.
